A sure thing in Dà Lat!
Nov 2025 • Couples
5 stars for the very warm welcome, a smiling manager and who speaks English, which makes communication and explanation of the dishes very appreciable. 
Simple decoration, a cozy little restaurant. 
A complete menu with vegetarian/vegan options, many possible accompaniments for fish, beef, pork, chicken, shrimp... In short, rich traditional Vietnamese cuisine, with generous and delicious dishes. 
The starters are simple, as for the dishes: 
I personally ordered vegetables with tofu, a simple dish but so comforting, it was delicious, I'm delighted to be able to eat vegan by being able to feast so much. 
My companion ordered a caramelized fish that he loved, his eyes still shine:)
The prices are very reasonable. 
This is a safe value in Dà Lat, we will return as soon as possible, thank you!
